column1: # The mutation audit of work package S2.5 (make_s25_mutants.py: 202 single-site mutants of the navigation side; run_s25_mutants.py: each built in Release and run in stages with a watchdog; host crash and hang count as killed). THE RUN WAS STOPPED BEFORE IT FINISHED (the owner asked to pause): 137 of the 202 mutants were run, 65 were NOT run.

# RESULT OF THE 137 THAT WERE RUN: 88 killed at stage 1 by the owning test classes (86 by failed assertions, 1 by a host crash, 1 by the watchdog); 49 SURVIVED STAGE 1 and their stage 2 (every default-set class of the navigation side, one run) ended at the 600 s watchdog: the run counts a hang as a kill, but this one is NOT a trustworthy kill (the unmutated stage 2 itself takes more than 10 minutes with three runners sharing 4 cores: the Navigation classes alone took 14 min 36 s when the machine was quiet). Those 49 are therefore reported as SURVIVORS OF STAGE 1 WITH STAGE 2 INCONCLUSIVE: each is a test gap to close or an equivalent mutant to argue, and none of that was done (s25_equivalent.py is empty: nothing was argued). Stage 3 (the Large tests) was never reached.
# Families of the 49 stage-1 survivors: A: 5, L: 5, N: 7, P: 21, R: 5, W: 6.

# not run, by family: P (the 32-bit kernels of the pack: P40-P46, P50-P62, P70-P80), Q (Q01-Q04, new for the split of the 32-bit link at 9109af24), P56b (new), N (N07, N08), F (the reading of the RMQ entry of a container: F01-F13), X (X01-X07), V (the vetting of suffix array entries in the 32-bit navigator: V01-V07; V06 and V07 new for the field _vetSa). Seven mutants were added for the code of commit 9109af24 (P56b, Q01-Q04, V06, V07) and seven had their patterns rewritten for it (P50, P51, P55, P56, V01, V02, V04): all fourteen are among the NOT RUN. The first listing of 195 mutants (before 9109af24) had the ids P57-P62 once; the new ones are Q01-Q04 so that the ids are unique.

# The in-flight mutants at the stop were not counted; the worktrees were restored (git checkout) and removed. Three runners in parallel (worktrees at 9109af24), limits 600 s build / 600 s test / 900 s large.
